cells.A1: Tensor T1: fill B2:D4 with numbers 1..9

hints: Put a small block of numbers (e.g. 9 values in B2:D4) — that block is your tensor T1. Make the numbers concrete, like 1..9.
Before touching formulas, predict: how many rows and columns does your block have, and how many values are in it?
Inspect the results: the shape formula should read rows x columns (e.g. 3x3) and the size formula should equal the count of values (e.g. 9).
